title: Heat Drop — Oblique Sneaker Hero
description: A SNKRS-inspired drop announcement built on a clipped product shot, oversized italic type slamming over the shoe, and a monospaced pill chip counting down the release. The diagonal color block injects momentum that flat sportswear layouts refuse to deliver.
philosophy: This template exists for the instant before the drop — urgency without explanation, product without apology. It rejects symmetry, comfortable margins, and anything that reads like a corporate one-pager. The diagonal stripe is not decoration; it is a dividing line between hype and noise. Designed for feeds and rooms where visual authority is the only currency that matters.
goodFor: Streetwear or athletic brand campaign reveal slides
Social-media-format hype slides embedded in pitch decks
avoidFor: Multi-column data tables or dense footnote layouts
Academic, legal, or government-facing formal presentations
author: harness

examples.promptCore: Raw drop-culture energy — the slide feels like a warehouse reveal with strobes half on, product commanding the room before a single word is spoken. Composition is aggressively asymmetric: the diagonal stripe acts as a tectonic fault line splitting restraint from chaos, giving the layout velocity that no horizontal grid can replicate. Type is hurled at the canvas with controlled aggression, overlapping the shoe without apology or alignment anxiety. Avoid anything centered, padded, or balanced — this slide should feel like it arrived fast and dares you to blink.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed canvas with zero outer margin; a diagonal color block slices from the lower-left corner toward the upper-right, acting as the structural spine that divides the slide into two charged zones. Product shot is clipped hard against the right canvas edge — no padding, no breathing room — occupying roughly the right half of the composition. Oversized italic headline spans cols 1–9 of a 12-col grid, crashing across both the diagonal boundary and the product silhouette simultaneously. A monospaced countdown pill chip anchors the lower-left quadrant below the diagonal; no header band, no page number, nothing that signals navigation.

examples.promptCore: Feels like a centerfold spread from a limited-run drop zine — raw, deliberate, confrontational. The diagonal stripe cleaves the slide into two charged zones: dense product intel pinned against the hard edge below, kinetic negative space commanding the upper field. Callout chips read like scoreboard data, clinical and cold against the high-energy backdrop. Avoid any compositional rhythm that feels settled or symmetrical — this slide should feel mid-drop, not post-announcement.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-col grid, zero outer margin — full-bleed edge discipline throughout. Diagonal color block cuts lower-left to upper-right at roughly one-third height, acting as a hard compositional floor; a tight cluster of 2–3 monospaced pill-chip callouts stacks in cols 7–12 just above the stripe. Primary stat or feature copy occupies cols 1–6, pressed low against the diagonal edge, while a clipped product fragment bleeds off the right boundary. Release date or sequential slide number anchors bottom-left in the gutter, flush to trim.
